# Vendored asmoWBW v0.2.1

This tree is asmoWBW v0.2.1, built by Spades Project Dev for BootLister.

Do not change the naming, fact, or media-optimization logic here. Updates should come from a new asmoWBW release, then be copied into this folder.

BootLister calls it with:

    python -m asmo_wbw run --in listing.json --out-dir out/ --og-base-url https://bootlister.vercel.app

See INTEGRATION.md and the contracts in specs/.
